eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Ouray, CO; at 5:30 PM on JUL 29, 2026 Effective until 7:30 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Ouray Sheriff - EVACUATION ORDER for intense flooding in area of Citadel Dr to Old School Rd east of US 550 in Ouray County in area of Ponderosa Village and Cutler Creek Dr due to intense flooding. Evacuate NOW to safety or climb to high ground. If you are trapped, dial 9-1-1. Ridgway Secondary School is evacuation center.  More info - OurayCountyCO.gov Ouray County Sheriff is issuing an EVACUATION ORDER for the area of Citadel Dr to Old School Rd east of US 550 in the area of Ponderosa Village and Cutler Creek Dr between Ridgway and Ouray in Ouray County due to active intense flooding. If you are home and able to, emergency services is directing residents to EVACUATE the area for your safety! Extreme flooding is occurring in this area due to heavy rain on the Gold Mtn burn scar. Please evacuate to the Ridgway Secondary School for an evacuation Center. Additional info at OurayCountyCO.gov
